composition: Stacked poster headlines occupy the left or full width. The Card object sits as a 3D or high-res physical plate. Sections alternate shout-type and object close-ups.
typography: Expressive display, tight leading, broken lines. Body is short and imperative ('Share it. Be noticed.').
palette: Vivid fields against ink. Not a two-stop luxury pair — poster color is allowed to change by section if the object stays recognizable.
geometry: Poster blocks + one object. Avoid equal columns.
navigation: Short. The pitch is a linear poster sequence.
motion: 3D object idle + section-enter type. Color fields may swap on scroll.
interaction: Card may tilt. Lists do not have to hover-animate.
imagery: Sculptural 3D + the Card. People appear later as members, not as stock handshake.
materials: Plastic/metal card, matte poster ink, occasional glossy 3D.
spatial_rhythm: Shout / object / numbered practice / directory pitch.
responsive: Poster type scales down but stays large. Card goes full width. 3D idle slows or becomes a still.
signature_motif: Physicalized membership token surrounded by poster type
rejected_defaults: marketplace grid of artworks as the hero
